note: Minified release bundle sizes in bytes (all remeasured 2026-10-10 after the second simplification pass: hub-owned registration, one shared host binding, plain modules). Budgets allow up to 5% growth rounded up to whole KiB. Raise one only with the reason recorded in this note. Code-analysis implementation: Multiscreen remeasured at 33,365 bytes for independent bounded page queues, scene search, retained split-lane selections, independent native player identities and native source menus; its budget is 34 KiB. Rank remeasured at 117,950 bytes for retained vote comparison sums, shifted cold weights, bounded task yielding, shared cancellable preparation and complete-score rendering; its budget is 121 KiB (5% rounded up). Other budgets are unchanged. DirtyTidy was remeasured at 24,680 bytes for the tagger-source picker, validation, source loading/retry, queued-job feedback and forced refresh with one-day cache guidance. DirtyTasks now combines those organization/tag features with additive encoding, isolated section saves and migration; output review is removed. Its initial budget is 60 KiB. DirtyTasks 1.0.1 adds the shared Manual/Scan/Generate setting and retains the existing 60 KiB budget. DirtyTasks 1.0.2 adds independent action/rule trigger selectors and retains the existing 60 KiB budget. DirtyTasks 1.0.3 adds conditional recovery status and warning feedback within the existing 60 KiB budget. DirtyPlugins 1.0.8 was remeasured at 46,719 bytes (about 1.75 KB more than 1.0.7) for the header settings button and its show/hide setting; its budget is 48 KiB (5% rounded up). DirtyStats 1.0.9 moves ECharts and the world map into assets/dirtyStatsCharts.js, which loads only when a Stats page opens: the bundle every Stash page loads drops from 1,151,287 to 160,315 bytes (budget 165 KiB), and the chart file is recorded as a chunk at 1,000,127 bytes (budget 1026 KiB). DirtyMultiscreen 1.0.17 was remeasured at 36,978 bytes for seven scene orders (weighted, fewer-repeats and mixed shuffles) and performer/studio spreading; its budget is 38 KiB (5% rounded up). DirtyTasks 1.0.5 was remeasured at 61,499 bytes for encoding Pause/Resume and size comparisons with the originals; its budget is 64 KiB (5% rounded up). DirtyStats was remeasured at 176,603 bytes for the Scenes per studio chart and the Tag DNA bar and cluster views with their clustering and layout; its budget is 182 KiB (5% rounded up). Its chart file was remeasured at 1,010,153 bytes for the sunburst series, within its existing budget. DirtyPlugins was remeasured at 58,719 bytes for NavIcon, which holds the five navigation icons in a set for each of the eight suite themes and replaces the artwork in Stats, Rank and Multiscreen; its budget is 61 KiB (5% rounded up). DirtyMultiscreen 1.0.22 was remeasured at 40,957 bytes for per-performer portrait buttons with Next overlays, missing-photo fallbacks, capture-mode privacy, bounded session continuation searches, loading and no-match feedback, and retry handling; its budget remains 42 KiB (5% rounded up). DirtyMultiscreen was remeasured at 44,390 bytes for saved sessions that return each screen to its scene, position and audio after a closed tab or reload; its budget is 46 KiB (5% rounded up). DirtyMultiscreen was remeasured at 47,506 bytes (841 more than the faster performer navigation, which had reached 46,665) for tag list, tag selection and tag page launch contexts; its budget is 49 KiB (5% rounded up). DirtyMultiscreen was remeasured at 52,539 bytes (5,033 more) for lists announced by other plugins through stash-scenes:context: validation, per-page provider lists, the Advanced settings, ID lists loaded one page at a time, search and performer navigation that scan matching IDs, and Next repeating a scene when every other one is on a screen; its budget is 54 KiB (5% rounded up). DirtyMultiscreen was remeasured at 59,391 bytes (6,852 more) for edit mode: per-screen flip, loop and fill controls kept in the saved session, the grid picker with its confirmation dialog, and screens swapped by two clicks or by a drag that carries the playing screen under the pointer; its budget is 61 KiB (5% rounded up). DirtyMultiscreen was remeasured at 64,897 bytes for saved grids: the dialog that saves, opens, replaces, renames and deletes them, per-pane items in a grid snapshot, and restarting the player on an opened grid; its budget is 67 KiB (5% rounded up). DirtyMultiscreen phase 4 was remeasured at 68,641 bytes for Fit videos: contiguous justified row/column layout, live size and viewport reflow, independent mode persistence and saved-grid restoration; its budget is 71 KiB (5% rounded up). DirtyMultiscreen was remeasured at 69,262 bytes for per-video quarter-turn rotation, inverse aspect ratios in Fit videos and persisted rotation validation; its budget is 72 KiB (5% rounded up).
